properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure  located a few hundred miles east of Bermuda remain disorganized.  Development appears less likely than previously anticipated,  although some slight development remains possible during the next  couple of days as the system moves slowly westward over the  subtropical Atlantic. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...20 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.

Disorganized showers and thunderstorms continue with a tropical wave  located several hundred miles south of Southwestern Mexico.  Environmental conditions remain conducive for gradual development of  this system, and a tropical depression is likely to form late this  weekend or early next week while it moves gradually northwestward  and then northward off the coast of southwestern Mexico. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...near 0 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

Showers and thunderstorms associated with a broad area of low  pressure located well west-southwest of the southern tip of the Baja  California Peninsula remain disorganized. Environmental conditions  appear conducive for additional development of this system, and a  tropical depression is likely to form this weekend as it moves  westward at 10 to 15 mph across the western part of the East Pacific  and into the central Pacific basin. 
 Formation chance through 48 hours...medium...40 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...high...80 percent.

properties.nhcTitle: Well East-Southeast of the Hawaiian Islands (Former TD15-E)
properties.discussion:
Showers and thunderstorms continue in association with the remnants  of Tropical Depression Fifteen-E. Environmental conditions appear  only marginally conducive for some development of this system as it  moves gradually westward, remaining east-southeast of the Hawaiian  Islands.  
 Formation chance through 48 hours...low...10 percent. 
 Formation chance through 7 days...low...20 percent.
